limitations: Reconstructed today; not saved pregame forecasts and not an independently observed betting record.
Universe is the current 197-player list selected later in the season; selection/survivorship bias remains.
Today's season valuation priors are excluded. Prior means use pre-2026 player statistics (last 16 games), with a 2025 position-cohort fallback.
Prior SD seed uses 2021-2025 statistics. Current injury news, current roster reserve status and target-week performance are not forecast features.
Roster status is lagged through the previous week. Week 1 team identity is administrative metadata; availability is unverified and target-week roster status is not used numerically.

Timestamped full historical injury/lineup archives are unavailable. Injury timing and activation/trade-week errors are not fully backtested; DNPs and unresolved/team-change rows do not train conditional performance.
No archived Week 1-7 sportsbook lines/odds were verified. No ROI, prop win rate or historical betting edge is claimed.
Walk-forward performance uses parameters fit only to earlier weeks; after Week 7 all eligible errors form a downweighted warm start (0.25 per reconstructed record).
Downloaded historical statistics can include later official stat corrections; exact originally published values cannot be recovered.
